notes: Waves run in order. Cases inside one wave run in parallel (up to --workers at a time).
A case may share a wave only if it does not change Shop Settings, and does not change or depend on a rate that another case in the same wave changes.
Cases that change Shop Settings (setPricing, payment allocation rule) must not overlap with other cases. They run in a "serial" wave: one browser session, in spec order, after the parallel waves.
Cases that pick a specific physical cylinder (POS-P14 filled, POS-P19 empty) must not share a wave with gas or cylinder sales of the same type, or the cylinder can change under them.
Keep this file in step with testcase.md when cases are added or changed.
